baselines.package.json:
{
  "name": "my-app",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "workspaces": [
    "apps/*",
    "packages/*"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "turbo dev",
    "build": "turbo build",
    "check-types": "turbo check-types",
    "dev:native": "turbo -F native dev",
    "dev:server": "turbo -F server dev",
    "db:push": "turbo -F @my-app/db db:push",
    "db:studio": "turbo -F @my-app/db db:studio",
    "db:generate": "turbo -F @my-app/db db:generate",
    "db:migrate": "turbo -F @my-app/db db:migrate",
    "knip": "knip",
    "knip:production": "knip --production"
  },
  "packageManager": "npm@10.9.2",
  "overrides": {
    "@vitejs/devtools": "0.4.1"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "dotenv": "^17.4.2",
    "zod": "^4.4.3",
    "@my-app/env": "*"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "typescript": "^6.0.3",
    "@my-app/config": "*",
    "turbo": "^2.10.0",
    "knip": "^6.32.0"
  }
}
